name: Voxel Mesh Generation with Adjacency Culling
definition: A technique to generate a mesh from a voxel grid by iterating through active blocks and constructing cube geometry only for faces that are exposed (i.e., adjacent to inactive blocks or the world boundary), thereby preventing triangles from connecting across voxel boundaries.
summary: Voxel Mesh Generation with Adjacency Culling constructs meshes by generating geometry only for faces adjacent to inactive blocks or boundaries, eliminating internal occluded faces to reduce vertex count and prevent visual artifacts.
